description: Clarendon Paperbacks issue of Feeney's study of the role of the gods in the classical epic tradition, first published in 1991 and first issued in paperback by Oxford University Press in 1993. Trade paperback in the red pictorial wrappers; no dust jacket, as issued. Binding sound and the text complete and otherwise clean; includes bibliographical references and index.
